# PixelTrim

Resize and compress images right in your browser. Nothing is uploaded; all processing happens locally with the Canvas API.

Features: drag-and-drop, resize by width/height, JPEG/PNG/WebP export, quality slider.

Planned: batch processing, EXIF stripping, dark mode.
